Per role, estimated from isolated kernel times
Each kernel timed alone by BoltBeam's kernel timer, cold (the cache swept by
a read before every call), outside the engine: llama.cpp's own
kernel_mul_mv_q4_K_f32 and others, from the installed ggml source. Alone and
cold is slower than inside the token, where the cache is warm and launches
overlap. Sum alone: 54.3 ms, less the 1.9 µs dispatch floor per launch: 53.8
ms (the estimate uses this); the real token: 66.0 ms. Measurement: generic
(kernel timer), chosen in Setup.
EST. columns (estimate from isolated times): not scaled: 53.8 ms alone less
the 1.9 µs dispatch floor per launch fits the 66.0 ms token.
µs/call is the measured time, floor included; less floor, GB/s and % of peak
are less the 1.9 µs dispatch floor per launch.

ROLE                        QUANT  µs/CALL  LESS FLOOR  WHY
feed-forward in             Q4_K   324.2    322.4       at the limit
attention query and output  Q4_K   113.8    112.0       at the limit
feed-forward out            Q6_K   473.8    471.9       at the limit
attention keys and values   Q4_K   40.7     38.8        slow kernel
feed-forward out            Q4_K   315.1    313.2       at the limit
attention keys and values   Q6_K   50.3     48.5        slow kernel
vocabulary output           Q6_K   5407.8   5406.0      at the limit
Why: At the limit: 85% of peak or more. Too small to fill memory: a call
moves under 1.8 MB, which is 10 x the 0.18 MB that must be in flight (98
GB/s x 1.9 µs latency, the dispatch floor the probe measured on this GPU,
Little's law). Compute bound: the roofline regime is compute. Slow kernel:
below the limit, the call big enough, not compute bound, the chip not
throttled. Anything else: unexplained. Timed alone: % of peak and GB/s are
on the time less the 1.9 µs dispatch floor per launch; µs/call is the
measured time with the floor in it. Noisy: the role's own samples spread
more than ±10% (half of P90 - P10 over the median), or the dispatch floor is
over 33% of its measured time (the kernel is mostly floor), so the word is
not firm.
Kernel search: skipped. skipped with --no-search
Evidence: llama_timing_trace.json, model_profile.json, machine_facts.json,
measure_status.json
Per-role source: isolated (BoltBeam kernel timer, llama.cpp kernels from
ggml 0.19.0 at /opt/homebrew/opt/ggml/libexec/libggml-metal.so)
